definition.script:
pipeline { agent any
environment { REPO_SSH = 'git@github.com:hms-dbmi/avillachlab-jenkins-bdc-etl.git' BRANCH = 'jenkins-backup-nightly' }
stages { stage('Backup Jenkins config to git') { steps { withCredentials([sshUserPrivateKey( credentialsId: 'bdc-etl-jenkins-push', keyFileVariable: 'SSH_KEY', usernameVariable: 'SSH_USER' )]) { sh '''#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
install -d -m 700 "$HOME/.ssh" KNOWN_HOSTS="$HOME/.ssh/known_hosts" grep -v '^github\\.com ' "$KNOWN_HOSTS" 2>/dev/null > "$KNOWN_HOSTS.tmp" || true ssh-keyscan -t ed25519 github.com >> "$KNOWN_HOSTS.tmp" 2>/dev/null mv "$KNOWN_HOSTS.tmp" "$KNOWN_HOSTS" chmod 600 "$KNOWN_HOSTS"
export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i '$SSH_KEY' -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile='$KNOWN_HOSTS'"
WORKDIR="$(mktemp -d)" trap 'rm -rf "$WORKDIR"' EXIT cd "$WORKDIR"
git clone --no-tags "$REPO_SSH" repo cd repo
git config user.name "jenkins" git config user.email "jenkins@hms-dbmi.local"
git fetch origin "$BRANCH" || true if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/origin/$BRANCH"; then git checkout -B "$BRANCH" "origin/$BRANCH" else git checkout -B "$BRANCH" fi git pull --ff-only origin "$BRANCH" 2>/dev/null || true
cd jenkins-docker rm -rf jobs jobs_old var mkdir -p jobs
( cd "${JENKINS_HOME}/jobs" find . -type f -name "config.xml" -print0 \ | tar --null -T - -cf - \ | (cd "$WORKDIR/repo/jenkins-docker/jobs" && tar -xf -) )
cp -f "${JENKINS_HOME}/config.xml" . cp -f "${JENKINS_HOME}/plugins.txt" . cp -f "${JENKINS_HOME}/scriptApproval.xml" .
cd .. git add -A
if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "No changes detected; nothing to push" exit 0 fi
git commit -m "Jenkins backup: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" git push -u origin "$BRANCH" ''' } } } } }
